description: Post a message to a room. Mention people with @<slug>. Reply to the room a message came from by passing its roomId as room. Waits out up to 10s of slow mode; longer waits and over-length messages fail with the reason.

as.description: Identity slug to act as (default: the active identity)

files.description: Local file paths to attach (up to 10, 8 MB each)

mention.description: Members to @mention by display name or slug ("all" for everyone); added to the start of the text

room.description: roomId or index from huddo_list, for this call only (default: the default room)

name: huddo_send
